content.content: When invoked as `deccy new`, the form's flags are recognized in any order: `-m <summary>` may precede, follow, or interleave with the repeated `--on <id>` flags.
content.rationale: The form names flags, not positions — D12 fixes what the invocation carries, not the spelling order it carries them in. Fixing recognition as order-free keeps invocations that name the same parts equivalent, and keeps the verb from imposing a spelling no parent fixed.
